newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bangladesh gets $134.4 mln loan for power project.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh gets $134.4 mln loan for power project.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank said on Thursday its board had approved a $134.4 million loan to partly finance the transmission and distribution components of Bangladesh's first private power plant.

"The transmission and distribution project will proceed alongside the Meghnaghat power project for which five private firms have been short-listed for construction. Both projects are due for completion around mid-2000," the Manila-based multilateral financing institution said.
The transmission line will increase Dhaka's power supply by 500 to 600 megawatts, benefitting more than 100,000 households.
The loan is sourced from ADB's interest-free facility. It is repayable over 40 years including a 10-year grace period and carries a service charge of one percent every year.
The World Bank is providing a cofinancing of $63.3 million.
